affected_predicate.description: Google Maps visibly obtains a driving-duration result for the Orlando-to-Miami trip.

competing_trace_defects.description: The prefix repeatedly clicks within the numbered suggestion interface without a visible state change or executing the search.
Repeated attempts to enter Susan's phone number leave the New conversation screen visibly unchanged, so no recipient, message composition, or send action is observed.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the agent skips the Maps sign-in prompt. Maps then becomes usable and later visibly shows an Orlando-to-Miami route of 3 hr 25 min. The reused premise about unclear suggestions does not visibly create or preserve a defect in obtaining the driving duration.

summary: The reused false search-history premise is followed by a skip-sign-in action that does not visibly harm the driving-duration subgoal; Maps later displays the route duration. Separate visible loops occur in the prefix search interactions and in recipient entry.
